gap: No result ChatGPT got mentions the Fenix E06R PRO RG. Fenix sells it for $84.95 on its US store, and it has a green laser, a combined 1,600 lm Instant Turbo, IP66 and a built-in 1,650 mAh battery. Fenix's other model, the E06R that ChatGPT showed at $55.95, has only a red laser.
standout_why: I read faithstitchedhome.com, which names only the Klein 56040, the Klein 56074 and an EverBrite light, with no prices. I also read the answer text from all three ChatGPT chats, which used the cited Popular Mechanics, Lowe's, Yahoo and Dealectric pages plus the Coast, Walmart and Lowe's listings. The only Fenix any of them name is the red-laser E06R. None lists a green-laser Fenix, and none notes that the two Wuben X5 laser versions cost the same. I couldn't load the Popular Mechanics review (fetch refused), so I only know what ChatGPT quoted from it.
decides: This keeps the Wuben X5 as the value pick for a green laser: $79.99 on Wuben's own store for either the Class 3R or the Class 1 version (list price $99.99), with a replaceable battery. It also adds the Fenix E06R PRO RG as the nearest rival at $5 more. Fenix gives the E06R PRO RG more white light than the X5 (1,600 lm turbo against 1,300) but a sealed battery. ChatGPT's cheap Fenix pick (E06R, $55.95) should be marked red laser only. The Klein 56074, its 'best for work' pick, should be marked as a Class 2 green laser at under 1 mW according to Klein.
